### Download and load in dataset

```{r}
shark_data <- RKaggle::get_dataset("thedevastator/global-shark-attack-incidents")
```

### View main incidents table

```{r}
# Main incidents table
shark <- shark_data[[1]]
```

### Inspect column names

```{r}
# Inspect column names
colnames(shark)
```

### Filter to relevant columns

```{r}
# Keep only meaningful columns
shark_clean <- shark |>
  select(
    `Case Number`,
    Date,
    Type,
    country,
    area,
    location,
    activity,
    injury,
    `fatal`,
    Time,
    Species
  )

# Inspect
glimpse(shark_clean)
```

### Create injury severity categories

```{r}
shark_clean <- shark_clean |>
  mutate(
    injury_cat = case_when(
      `fatal` == "Y" | str_detect(tolower(injury), "fatal") ~ "Fatal",
      str_detect(tolower(injury), "severe")                       ~ "Severe",
      str_detect(tolower(injury), "minor")                        ~ "Minor",
      TRUE                                                        ~ "No injury / Unknown"
    )
  )

injury_levels <- c("Fatal", "Severe", "Minor", "No injury / Unknown")

injury_pal <- colorFactor(
  palette = brewer.pal(4, "YlOrRd"),
  domain  = injury_levels,
  levels  = injury_levels
)
```

### Aggregate to the country

```{r}
shark_country <- shark_clean |>
  filter(!is.na(country), country != "") |>
  mutate(
    fatal_flag = if_else(`fatal` == "Y", 1L, 0L)
  ) |>
  group_by(country) |>
  summarise(
    n_incidents   = n(),
    n_fatal       = sum(fatal_flag),
    fatal_rate    = n_fatal / n_incidents,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Convert country names to ISO3 codes for mapping
shark_country <- shark_country |>
  mutate(
    iso3 = countrycode(country,
                       origin = "country.name",
                       destination = "iso3c",
                       warn = FALSE)
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(iso3))

head(shark_country)
```

### Load world polygons

```{r}
# Cell 9: Load world polygons and join shark data
world_sf <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

# Join shark data to world polygons
world_shark <- world_sf |>
  left_join(shark_country, by = c("iso_a3" = "iso3"))
```

### Create incident categories

```{r}
# Cell 10: Create incident categories (robust breaks)
world_shark <- world_shark |>
  mutate(
    log_incidents = log1p(n_incidents)  # log(1 + x) to handle zeros
  )

# Create breaks that are guaranteed to be unique
breaks <- unique(
  quantile(world_shark$log_incidents,
           probs = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25),
           na.rm = TRUE)
)

# If there are very few unique values, fall back to simpler breaks
if (length(breaks) < 2) {
  breaks <- c(min(world_shark$log_incidents, na.rm = TRUE),
              max(world_shark$log_incidents, na.rm = TRUE))
}

# Ensure min and max are covered
breaks <- c(min(breaks), breaks, max(breaks))
breaks <- unique(breaks)

# Now create categories
world_shark <- world_shark |>
  mutate(
    inc_cat = cut(
      log_incidents,
      breaks = breaks,
      include.lowest = TRUE,
      labels = paste0("Q", seq_len(length(breaks) - 1))
    )
  )
```

### Build and display interactive map

```{r}
# Cell 11: Build and display the interactive map

inc_pal <- colorFactor(
  palette = brewer.pal(min(length(levels(world_shark$inc_cat)), 5), "Blues"),
  domain  = levels(world_shark$inc_cat),
  levels  = levels(world_shark$inc_cat)
)

popup_country <- paste0(
  "<strong>Country:</strong> ", world_shark$name, "<br/>",
  "<strong>Incidents:</strong> ", ifelse(is.na(world_shark$n_incidents), 0, world_shark$n_incidents), "<br/>",
  "<strong>Fatal:</strong> ", ifelse(is.na(world_shark$n_fatal), 0, world_shark$n_fatal), "<br/>",
  "<strong>Fatal rate:</strong> ",
  scales::percent(ifelse(is.na(world_shark$fatal_rate), 0, world_shark$fatal_rate), accuracy = 0.1)
)

m_country <- leaflet(world_shark) |>
  addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron") |>
  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~inc_pal(inc_cat),
    fillOpacity = 0.8,
    color = "white",
    weight = 0.5,
    smoothFactor = 0.5,
    popup = popup_country,
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
      color = "yellow",
      weight = 2,
      bringToFront = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    pal = inc_pal,
    values = ~inc_cat,
    title = "Shark incidents (log scale)",
    position = "bottomright",
    opacity = 0.9
  ) |>
  setView(lng = -150, lat = 20, zoom = 3)

# Add title
title_html <- tags$div(
  tags$h3(
    "Global Shark Attack Incidents by Country",
    style = "position:absolute; top:10px; left:50px; z-index:1000;
           background: rgba(255,255,255,0.85); padding: 6px 10px;
           border-radius: 4px; font-family: sans-serif; margin: 0;"
  )
)

m_country <- m_country |> addControl(title_html, position = "topleft")

# Display the map
m_country

# Optional: save as standalone HTML
# saveWidget(m_country, "shark_attacks_by_country.html", selfcontained = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# ---- Shiny UI and server ----

ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("DS421 Final Project – Global Shark Attack Incidents"),
  leafletOutput("sharkMap", height = "700px")
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  output$sharkMap <- renderLeaflet({
    m_country
  })
}

shinyApp <- shinyApp(ui, server)
```

```{r}
shinyApp(ui, server)
```
